siege.name: Castle Siege
phrases: The iron walls stand before us. Breach the gates!
A fortress of evil. It falls today!
They think their stone hides will save them. They're wrong.
Bring up the heavy hardware. We're going in!
The castle looms. Steel your hearts!
No wall is too high for a determined soul.
Break the defenses, end the reign.
Silence the cannons and take the keep!
The siege begins. Leave nothing standing!
One last gate between us and victory.

ambush.name: Shadow Ambush
phrases: Quiet... the air is too still. THE SHADOWS ARE MOVING!
Wait... where did the birds go?
I smell cold steel and regret. Ambush!
The shadows just blinked. WATCH OUT!
Eyes up! They're coming from the treeline!
A trap! Form a circle!
They were waiting for us. MAKE THEM REGRET IT!
Darkness strikes from all sides!
Don't let them isolate you!
The void has teeth. Stay sharp!

horde.name: Orc Warband
phrases: The ground shakes. A massive horde approaches!
Too many... there are just too many!
They're coming in waves! HOLD THE LINE!
A green tide is rising. Don't drown!
Their drums... they're calling for blood.
More goblins than I have arrows!
Brace yourselves! The swarm is here!
They aren't smart, but they are many.
Hack and slash until none are left!
A warband of monsters. Let's thin the herd.

pass.name: Mountain Pass
phrases: Watch the heights! They've got us pinned in the pass.
One way in, one way out. And they're in the way.
Rocks above, Orcs ahead. Not a great day.
The mountain air is thin, and the steel is cold.
Narrow path, dangerous enemies. Keep moving!
Don't let them push us off the edge!
Heights favor the archers. Find cover!
The pass is guarded. We break through or we die here.
Climb and conquer!
A tactical nightmare. Let's make it their nightmare.

village.name: Village Defense
phrases: The villagers are fleeing! Hold the line at the cottages!
Smoke on the horizon. The village is under attack!
Protect the homes! Drive them back into the dirt!
They're looting the stores! NOT ON MY WATCH!
Street to street, house to house. Clear them out!
The innocent depend on us. Don't fail them.
Save the village, earn your keep.
They're burning the thatch! Put them out!
Evacuate the children! We'll handle the green-skins.
A peaceful place turned into a slaughterhouse. End it.

forest.name: Cursed Forest
phrases: The woods are alive... and they're angry. Stay together!
Don't lose sight of each other. The mist is thickening.
Something is watching us from the ancient oaks.
Cursed trees and cold steel. Welcome to the forest.
I hear whispers in the leaves. They aren't friendly.
The forest floor is soaked in old blood.
Woodland spirits? No, just angry insurgents.
Tread carefully. The roots have eyes.
Shadows grow long in the deep woods.
The green silence is deafening.

river.name: River Crossing
phrases: The only way forward is across the water. Push through!
Watch the current! And the incoming fire!
Wet boots and bloody steel. The crossing begins!
They've got ballistae on the far bank! TAKE COVER!
Don't get bogged down in the shallows!
The river runs red today.
Hold the bridge! Don't let them flank us!
A tactical bottleneck. Move fast or get pinned!
Water is the enemy's shield. Break it.
Cross the stream, win the day.

cave.name: Cave Outbreak
phrases: They're pouring out of the deep dark! Brace for impact!
Cave-ins and Orc-ins. What a combination.
I hear heavy breathing from the tunnels.
Stale air and sharp blades. Welcome to the caves.
Don't get lost in the dark. They know the way better than us.
The mountain spits out its filth!
Echoes of steel on stone. The hunt is on.
Watch the ceiling! And your back!
A subterranean slaughter. Let's get to work.
The deep dark is hungry today.

ruins.name: Dead Man's Ruins
phrases: Scavengers pick through the bones. Clear them out!
Ancient glory, modern graves.
The ghosts of the past are joined by the corpses of the present.
Crumbling stone provides excellent cover. Use it.
This place was beautiful once. Now it's a tomb.
Dust and death. Keep your eyes peeled.
Ruined arches, ruined lives.
Clear the rubble, find the enemy.
The history here is written in blood.
Resting place of kings? Now it's just a killing field.

hunt.name: Elite Hunt
phrases: A high-ranking officer is spotted. Take his head!
Target acquired. Ignore the fodder, kill the leader!
The head of the snake is right there. Cut it off!
One death today matters more than all the rest.
Don't let the elite escape! Pursuit mode!
They've got a champion. Let's show them ours.
The hunt is on. Your trophy is waiting.
Precision strikes only. Focus on the target!
A high-value kill. Earn your bonus!
The boss is here. End his command.

maze.name: Orc Maze
phrases: A labyrinth of stone and stench. The Overlord waits at the center!
I hear heavy breathing... and it smells like bad breath.
A labyrinth of death. Watch every corner!
The Overlord is watching us. I can feel it.
Don't get separated in these corridors!
Every turn could be your last. Stay together!
The maze is a puzzle. The solution is violence.
They built this to trap us. Let's break the walls!
Stench of rot and stone. We're close.
Lost in the dark? Follow the sound of dying orcs.
